How a real result changes the next action

Verify one concrete assumption: For a button that does nothing, first check whether it has a click handler.

Read the actual result: The file shows that the click handler already exists, disproving the first assumption.

Change the investigation: A 401 after the click moves the next check to authentication. This is task state, not private chain of thought.

What people often confuse

ReAct is the alternation of task-level judgment, action, and observation. A tool call is one action; an agent loop controls permissions, retries, records, and stopping.
